title: Define ProtocolError variants covering all RFC 3977 failure modes
description:
Define ProtocolError: UnknownCommand, MissingMandatoryHeader(field_name), InvalidMessageId, InvalidGroupName, ArticleTooBig(size, limit), DateOutOfRange, DuplicateMessageId, NoGroupSelected, NotAuthenticated, LineTooLong. Each variant maps to a specific RFC 3977 response code. Implement a method response_code(&self) -> u16. Artifact: core/src/error.rs, ProtocolError sub-enum.

Acceptance criteria: every error variant has a response_code; unit test: each variant maps to a distinct response code matching RFC 3977; variants cover all command handler failure modes
